title: Martian World
description: Transform your Minecraft world into Mars with Martian World, explore vast red deserts, frozen tundras and dramatic volcanic plateaus in a breathtaking Mars-like landscape
body:
Martian World is a Minecraft data pack that replaces the standard Overworld with the red planet Mars. Gravity is reduced to 40%, safe fall distance is 15 blocks, and there is no access to the Nether or the End.

The surface is dominated by three distinct biomes that capture the essence of the Mars. The endless red sand desert covers 90% of the landscape, where Endermen wander among the dunes; the frozen tundra stretches across snowy plains, home to elusive Breezes; and the dramatic volcanic plateaus rise with layers of basalt, diorite, calcite, and amethyst, spawning Magma Cubes and Allays ready to assist.

Hidden across the vast desert lies your only path to survival a massive Martian base shaped like an iron hemisphere with a gleaming glass roof, towering antennas, and two sturdy airlocks. This mysterious outpost contains the minimal set of all natural renewable resources plus a handful of unusual rare and special items-everything you need to gather, explore, and begin building a future on Mars.

Beneath the surface, cave systems reveal iron, ice, water, and magma amid deepslate layers, where Slimes may spawn in open spaces. Locate the base, claim its treasures, and start your terraforming journey – growing trees, farming food, and raising livestock to gradually turn this hostile red world into a thriving new home.
